response.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM advancedbehavior WHERE peercorr > 0.149;

assumptions.assumption: 'High peer correlation' means peercorr strictly greater than the 0.149 cutoff; records with NULL peercorr are excluded.

alternatives.interpretation: High peer correlation includes records exactly at the cutoff (peercorr >= 0.149).
